story.text: Recorded history opened when founders Eve Dawn and Dawn Hope established rival dynasties thirty tiles apart, surviving on wild alliums and early textiles. Tragedy soon dismantled the northern branch when five-year-old Hope Dawn starved attempting to digest an ornamental rose hip, leaving Eve entirely without junior staff and manufacturing solitary cordage on an empty stomach. To the south, the Hope dynasty has embraced middle management. Founder Dawn welcomed newborn Joy and introduced warehousing via the basket, while delegating heavy industry to nine-year-old Faith. Faith has since produced civilization's first rope, flint chips, and a yew bow in an urgent bid for fire. Humanity remains level at four living souls, though three are currently stationed in southern logistics while the solitary north reconsiders its lunch schedule.
